**Given** I tap the pencil icon beside my name
**When** the field becomes editable
**Then** the pencil icon becomes a check icon — the only place in the product where an icon itself changes meaning rather than just color (UX-DR13).

**Given** I edit the name and confirm
**When** I save
**Then** `PATCH /account/settings` commits the change and the field reverts to display mode.

**Given** I tap elsewhere without confirming
**When** focus leaves the field
**Then** it also reverts to display mode — no separate "edit profile" screen exists.
**And** the 52px Settings avatar reuses the same avatar component built in Epic 1 (Story 1.6), not a reimplementation, now at its second fixed size.

### Story 8.4: Logout

As a user,
I want to log out cleanly,
So that I can hand my phone to someone else or step away without leaving my journal open.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** I tap "Sair"
**When** the action completes
**Then** `POST /auth/logout` ends the session and I'm routed to the Biometric Vault / login screen.

### Story 8.5: Account Deletion

As a user,
I want to permanently delete my account and all my data,
So that I retain genuine control over something this personal.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** I tap "Apagar conta"
**When** the confirmation dialog appears

## Technical Decisions

Both are thin — standard layer-dependency and Either-error-channel rules apply, nothing feature-specific beyond that.

Cache-invalidation behavior for the chart (recalculating after a new entry) is a presentation-layer concern owned by whoever builds this epic, not a shared local-cache mechanism.

- The 52px avatar shown here reuses the same avatar component already built earlier (previously only used at a 40px size) — do not reimplement it.
- Charting uses `fl_chart` (already pinned for the project).

1	---
2	title: 'Story 8.3: Profile Name Editing'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-07'
5	status: 'done'
6	review_loop_iteration: 0
7	context: []
8	baseline_commit: 'dd59fc845883a9e56ace167dadcdb435744ecf50'
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Configurações shows no avatar/name/email (still the Story 2.4 toggle-only stub) and has no way to edit the display name (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.3 scope).
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a profile header (52dp avatar + name/email) above the biometric toggle. A pencil icon switches the name to an inline `AppTextField`; it becomes a check that saves via the existing `account-settings-update` PATCH and reverts to display mode. Tapping away unconfirmed reverts without saving.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- `AccountSettingsDto` decodes `displayName`/`email` too (required strings), full-contract-decode precedent as `DashboardNarrativeDto`.
23	- No new network call: `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s success branch also sets new `_currentDisplayName`/`_currentEmail` (default `''`) from that response.
24	- New `setDisplayName(String)`: own `_nameGeneration` guard (shape of `setBiometricEnabled`'s `_generation`, kept separate), **not optimistic** — await `AccountRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName` (`{'displayName': name}`), set `_currentDisplayName` only on success.
25	- Cubit reads `displayName`/`email` from the repository at construction. New state: `isEditingName`, `nameDraft`, `isSavingName`, `nameErrorMessage`. New methods: `startEditingName()` (draft = current name), `updateNameDraft()`, `cancelEditingName()` (no-op while saving), `confirmEditingName()` — trims draft; empty/unchanged reverts with no PATCH; otherwise saves, staying in edit mode with the error on failure (draft kept) or reverting with the new name on success.
26	- Screen: header is the first scroll-`Column` child, above the toggle. `Avatar(size: AvatarSize.large)`, caller derives initials (first letter of first + last word). Name: `textTitleSm`+`colorTextPrimary`. Email: `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle`+`colorTextSecondary`. Icon: `Icons.edit`/`Icons.check`, `dialogIconSize`, `colorPrimary`, in `InkWell`+`ConstrainedBox(minHeight/minWidth: insertionModalTapTargetMin)` (tap-target fix, same as spec-8-2's retry link). Field + check icon in one `TapRegion(onTapOutside: cancelEditingName)`. Field: `AppTextField(controller, errorText: nameErrorMessage)`, no label/hint.
27	- `_announce` fires on a save failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the toggle's error.
28	- Keep `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s name even though it now also sets `displayName`/`email` — renaming ripples into `main.dart`/`vault_lock_screen.dart` for no functional gain.
29	
30	**Ask First:** None.
31	
32	**Never:** a second fetch for displayName/email; an optimistic flip for the name; persona/logout/delete UI (Stories 8.4/8.5); merging name-edit into the toggle's own state.
33	
34	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
35	
36	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
37	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
38	| Tap pencil | `isEditingName: false` | Field replaces name, draft = current, icon -> check | N/A |
39	| Confirm, changed non-empty name | tap check | PATCH, saving indicator, success -> display mode, new name | Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft kept |
40	| Confirm, empty/unchanged draft | tap check | Reverts immediately, no PATCH | N/A |
41	| Tap away, not saving | outside tap | Reverts, draft discarded, no PATCH | N/A |
42	| Tap away, saving | outside tap | No-op, save completes | N/A |
43	
44	</frozen-after-approval>
45	
46	## Code Map
47	
48	- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- add `displayName`/`email`
49	- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:11-47` -- add `updateDisplayName`, mirrors `updateBiometricEnabled`
50	- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:15-58` -- add `currentDisplayName`/`currentEmail`/`setDisplayName`
51	- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart:20-139` -- fields + boot-fetch piggyback + `setDisplayName`
52	- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` -- state/methods per Boundaries
53	- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:104-120` -- header, `TapRegion`, initials helper, `_announce`
54	- `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart` / `app_text_field.dart` -- reused as-is (first real `AvatarSize.large` consumer)
55	- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1737-1819` -- `PATCH /account/settings` (frozen), `displayName` optional, `minLength:1`/`maxLength:80`; `README.md:45` maps it to `account-settings-update`
56	- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:116` + raw prototype `toggleEditProfile`/`saveProfile`/`editIcon` -- pencil/check UX source
57	- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-8-context.md` -- authoritative AC source (no FR in `requirements.md` covers this)
58	- `test/features/account/**` -- extend `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository` + new coverage
59	
60	## Tasks & Acceptance
61	
62	**Execution:**
63	- [x] `account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- decode `displayName`/`email`
64	- [x] `account_remote_data_source.dart` -- `updateDisplayName`
65	- [x] `account_settings_repository.dart`/`_impl.dart` -- getters + `setDisplayName`, boot-fetch piggyback
66	- [x] `account_settings_cubit.dart` -- edit/draft/save/cancel state machine
67	- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- header, inline edit, `TapRegion`, tap-target fix, announcement
68	- [x] Tests: I/O matrix + the 3 RNF09 failure types for `updateDisplayName`; update existing fakes for the widened interface
69	
70	**Acceptance Criteria:**
71	- Given display mode, when the pencil is tapped, then the name becomes editable (pre-filled) and the icon becomes a check.
72	- Given a changed non-empty draft, when the check is tapped and save succeeds, then the screen shows the new name in display mode.
73	- Given a save fails, then the field stays editable with the typed text and an inline error.
74	- Given an unconfirmed edit, when the user taps outside the field/icon, then the screen reverts with no change sent.
75	
76	### Review Findings
77	
78	- [x] [Review][Patch] `confirmEditingName()`'s success branch emits `displayName: trimmed` (the locally-sent, merely-trimmed string) instead of re-reading `_repository.currentDisplayName` — defeats the repository's own code-review patch that sets `_currentDisplayName` from the response's echoed `dto.displayName` so any backend-side normalization is reflected locally. The cubit never re-reads the repository after construction, so a divergence persists for the rest of the singleton's session. [account_settings_cubit.dart:291] — fixed: emits `_repository.currentDisplayName` instead; both fakes' `setDisplayName` now set `currentDisplayName` on success (configurable echo override), with a new cubit test proving the echoed value wins over the locally-sent one.
79	- [x] [Review][Patch] The new sibling `BlocListener<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>` added to catch the narrative-errors-before-aggregate-resolves race has no `listenWhen` — it re-announces "narrativa indisponível" on every subsequent `DashboardCubit` emission with `totalCount > 30` (e.g. each further entry save via `confirmedWrites`) for as long as the narrative stays in `ResourceError`, not just once for the missed transition the fix was written for. [account_settings_screen.dart:485-504] — fixed: added a `listenWhen` that only fires on the transition into `totalCount > 30`.
80	- [x] [Review][Patch] `_nameController` is created empty in `initState()` on every mount; the only sync (`BlocListener` on the `!previous.isEditingName && current.isEditingName` transition) fires on state *transitions*, not on initial build. Leaving Configurações mid-edit (e.g. via the back arrow, which never calls `cancelEditingName`) and reopening it shows a blank field while the cubit's singleton state still holds `isEditingName: true` with the old `nameDraft` — tapping the check icon in that state silently saves the stale, invisible draft rather than the (empty) field the user sees. [account_settings_screen.dart:52-57] — fixed: `initState` seeds the controller (text + cursor position) from the cubit's current state when already mid-edit.
81	- [x] [Review][Patch] `fetchBiometricEnabled()` checks `generation != _generation` and returns early *before* ever checking `nameGeneration == _nameGeneration` — a fetch superseded only on its biometric-toggle generation (e.g. the double boot-time call in `main.dart`/`CerneApp.initState()` racing past the 2s `main()` timeout) discards its own still-valid `displayName`/`email` piggyback too, even though no `setDisplayName` call happened in between. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:111-144] — fixed: the `nameGeneration` piggyback now applies before the `generation` check, independent of whether the biometric-toggle generation was superseded.
82	- [x] [Review][Patch] No test uses `interceptAnnouncements` for the name-save-failure path — the sibling toggle-failure and narrative-failure tests in the same file all assert the accessibility channel receives the announcement, but the new "a failed save keeps the field editable..." test only checks `TextField`/error text, so a dropped or inverted `_announce` call on name-save failure would pass the full suite. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart (profile header group)] — fixed: added a dedicated test asserting the announcement via `interceptAnnouncements`.
83	- [x] [Review][Patch] `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository.setDisplayNameGate` is wired into the fake's `setDisplayName` but no test ever sets it — the saving-indicator (`CircularProgressIndicator`) and the "tap away while saving is a no-op" I/O-matrix row are proven only at the cubit level, never against the real screen widget, unlike every other row/AC in the matrix. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:68-80] — fixed: added a widget test using the gate to prove the saving indicator shows and tap-away is a no-op mid-save.
84	- [x] [Review][Patch] The profile e-mail `Text` has no `maxLines`/`overflow` handling, unlike the adjacent name `Text` which was patched for exactly this (backend allows up to 80 chars) — a long e-mail can still wrap to multiple lines and misalign the row. title: 'Story 8.3: Profile Name Editing'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-07'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: 'dd59fc845883a9e56ace167dadcdb435744ecf50'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações shows no avatar/name/email (still the Story 2.4 toggle-only stub) and has no way to edit the display name (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.3 scope).

**Approach:** Add a profile header (52dp avatar + name/email) above the biometric toggle. A pencil icon switches the name to an inline `AppTextField`; it becomes a check that saves via the existing `account-settings-update` PATCH and reverts to display mode. Tapping away unconfirmed reverts without saving.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `AccountSettingsDto` decodes `displayName`/`email` too (required strings), full-contract-decode precedent as `DashboardNarrativeDto`.
- No new network call: `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s success branch also sets new `_currentDisplayName`/`_currentEmail` (default `''`) from that response.
- New `setDisplayName(String)`: own `_nameGeneration` guard (shape of `setBiometricEnabled`'s `_generation`, kept separate), **not optimistic** — await `AccountRemoteDataSource.updateDisplayName` (`{'displayName': name}`), set `_currentDisplayName` only on success.
- Cubit reads `displayName`/`email` from the repository at construction. New state: `isEditingName`, `nameDraft`, `isSavingName`, `nameErrorMessage`. New methods: `startEditingName()` (draft = current name), `updateNameDraft()`, `cancelEditingName()` (no-op while saving), `confirmEditingName()` — trims draft; empty/unchanged reverts with no PATCH; otherwise saves, staying in edit mode with the error on failure (draft kept) or reverting with the new name on success.
- Screen: header is the first scroll-`Column` child, above the toggle. `Avatar(size: AvatarSize.large)`, caller derives initials (first letter of first + last word). Name: `textTitleSm`+`colorTextPrimary`. Email: `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle`+`colorTextSecondary`. Icon: `Icons.edit`/`Icons.check`, `dialogIconSize`, `colorPrimary`, in `InkWell`+`ConstrainedBox(minHeight/minWidth: insertionModalTapTargetMin)` (tap-target fix, same as spec-8-2's retry link). Field + check icon in one `TapRegion(onTapOutside: cancelEditingName)`. Field: `AppTextField(controller, errorText: nameErrorMessage)`, no label/hint.
- `_announce` fires on a save failure, same `BlocListener` convention as the toggle's error.
- Keep `fetchBiometricEnabled()`'s name even though it now also sets `displayName`/`email` — renaming ripples into `main.dart`/`vault_lock_screen.dart` for no functional gain.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** a second fetch for displayName/email; an optimistic flip for the name; persona/logout/delete UI (Stories 8.4/8.5); merging name-edit into the toggle's own state.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Tap pencil | `isEditingName: false` | Field replaces name, draft = current, icon -> check | N/A |
| Confirm, changed non-empty name | tap check | PATCH, saving indicator, success -> display mode, new name | Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft kept |
| Confirm, empty/unchanged draft | tap check | Reverts immediately, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, not saving | outside tap | Reverts, draft discarded, no PATCH | N/A |
| Tap away, saving | outside tap | No-op, save completes | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- add `displayName`/`email`
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart:11-47` -- add `updateDisplayName`, mirrors `updateBiometricEnabled`
- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart:15-58` -- add `currentDisplayName`/`currentEmail`/`setDisplayName`
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart:20-139` -- fields + boot-fetch piggyback + `setDisplayName`
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` -- state/methods per Boundaries
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:104-120` -- header, `TapRegion`, initials helper, `_announce`
- `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart` / `app_text_field.dart` -- reused as-is (first real `AvatarSize.large` consumer)
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1737-1819` -- `PATCH /account/settings` (frozen), `displayName` optional, `minLength:1`/`maxLength:80`; `README.md:45` maps it to `account-settings-update`
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:116` + raw prototype `toggleEditProfile`/`saveProfile`/`editIcon` -- pencil/check UX source
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-8-context.md` -- authoritative AC source (no FR in `requirements.md` covers this)
- `test/features/account/**` -- extend `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository` + new coverage

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `account_settings_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- decode `displayName`/`email`
- [x] `account_remote_data_source.dart` -- `updateDisplayName`
- [x] `account_settings_repository.dart`/`_impl.dart` -- getters + `setDisplayName`, boot-fetch piggyback
- [x] `account_settings_cubit.dart` -- edit/draft/save/cancel state machine
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` -- header, inline edit, `TapRegion`, tap-target fix, announcement
- [x] Tests: I/O matrix + the 3 RNF09 failure types for `updateDisplayName`; update existing fakes for the widened interface

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given display mode, when the pencil is tapped, then the name becomes editable (pre-filled) and the icon becomes a check.
- Given a changed non-empty draft, when the check is tapped and save succeeds, then the screen shows the new name in display mode.
- Given a save fails, then the field stays editable with the typed text and an inline error.
- Given an unconfirmed edit, when the user taps outside the field/icon, then the screen reverts with no change sent.

### Review Findings

- [x] [Review][Patch] `confirmEditingName()`'s success branch emits `displayName: trimmed` (the locally-sent, merely-trimmed string) instead of re-reading `_repository.currentDisplayName` — defeats the repository's own code-review patch that sets `_currentDisplayName` from the response's echoed `dto.displayName` so any backend-side normalization is reflected locally. The cubit never re-reads the repository after construction, so a divergence persists for the rest of the singleton's session. [account_settings_cubit.dart:291] — fixed: emits `_repository.currentDisplayName` instead; both fakes' `setDisplayName` now set `currentDisplayName` on success (configurable echo override), with a new cubit test proving the echoed value wins over the locally-sent one.
- [x] [Review][Patch] The new sibling `BlocListener<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>` added to catch the narrative-errors-before-aggregate-resolves race has no `listenWhen` — it re-announces "narrativa indisponível" on every subsequent `DashboardCubit` emission with `totalCount > 30` (e.g. each further entry save via `confirmedWrites`) for as long as the narrative stays in `ResourceError`, not just once for the missed transition the fix was written for. [account_settings_screen.dart:485-504] — fixed: added a `listenWhen` that only fires on the transition into `totalCount > 30`.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `_nameController` is created empty in `initState()` on every mount; the only sync (`BlocListener` on the `!previous.isEditingName && current.isEditingName` transition) fires on state *transitions*, not on initial build. Leaving Configurações mid-edit (e.g. via the back arrow, which never calls `cancelEditingName`) and reopening it shows a blank field while the cubit's singleton state still holds `isEditingName: true` with the old `nameDraft` — tapping the check icon in that state silently saves the stale, invisible draft rather than the (empty) field the user sees. [account_settings_screen.dart:52-57] — fixed: `initState` seeds the controller (text + cursor position) from the cubit's current state when already mid-edit.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `fetchBiometricEnabled()` checks `generation != _generation` and returns early *before* ever checking `nameGeneration == _nameGeneration` — a fetch superseded only on its biometric-toggle generation (e.g. the double boot-time call in `main.dart`/`CerneApp.initState()` racing past the 2s `main()` timeout) discards its own still-valid `displayName`/`email` piggyback too, even though no `setDisplayName` call happened in between. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:111-144] — fixed: the `nameGeneration` piggyback now applies before the `generation` check, independent of whether the biometric-toggle generation was superseded.
- [x] [Review][Patch] No test uses `interceptAnnouncements` for the name-save-failure path — the sibling toggle-failure and narrative-failure tests in the same file all assert the accessibility channel receives the announcement, but the new "a failed save keeps the field editable..." test only checks `TextField`/error text, so a dropped or inverted `_announce` call on name-save failure would pass the full suite. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart (profile header group)] — fixed: added a dedicated test asserting the announcement via `interceptAnnouncements`.
- [x] [Review][Patch] `_FakeAccountSettingsRepository.setDisplayNameGate` is wired into the fake's `setDisplayName` but no test ever sets it — the saving-indicator (`CircularProgressIndicator`) and the "tap away while saving is a no-op" I/O-matrix row are proven only at the cubit level, never against the real screen widget, unlike every other row/AC in the matrix. [test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:68-80] — fixed: added a widget test using the gate to prove the saving indicator shows and tap-away is a no-op mid-save.
- [x] [Review][Patch] The profile e-mail `Text` has no `maxLines`/`overflow` handling, unlike the adjacent name `Text` which was patched for exactly this (backend allows up to 80 chars) — a long e-mail can still wrap to multiple lines and misalign the row. [account_settings_screen.dart:220-224] — fixed: added matching `maxLines: 1`/`TextOverflow.ellipsis`.
- [x] [Review][Defer] `confirmEditingName()`'s `if (isClosed) return;` guard (same close()-race shape as `toggleBiometric`'s own) has no dedicated test — mirrors `toggleBiometric`'s own identical, also-untested guard, not a gap newly introduced for this feature. [account_settings_cubit.dart:267]
- [x] [Review][Defer] `_nameGeneration` only orders this client's own local state; it can't prevent the backend itself from processing two overlapping `setDisplayName` PATCH requests out of order, so a locally-"superseded" call's name could still be the one actually persisted server-side. Same residual risk class the existing `_generation` guard already carries for the biometric toggle, not fixable from the client given the frozen contract. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:152-176]
- [x] [Review][Defer] The `DashboardNarrativeCubit.confirmedWrites` "no `onError` handler" observation is recorded nearly verbatim in both `deferred-work.md` and spec-8-2's own Review Findings, with no cross-reference between the two — a future fix to one is likely to leave the other stale. [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md]
- [x] [Review][Defer] `tests/test-summary.md`'s hand-maintained pass-count tally has now drifted from the real `flutter test` count more than once (this diff's own edit corrects a prior miscounted baseline); nothing automated stops a future story's tally from drifting the same way again. [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/tests/test-summary.md]

- `fvm flutter test test/features/account` -- expected: all pass

[account_settings_screen.dart:485-504] — fixed: added a `listenWhen` that only fires on the transition into `totalCount > 30`.
+- [x] [Review][Patch] `_nameController` is created empty in `initState()` on every mount; the only sync (`BlocListener` on the `!previous.isEditingName && current.isEditingName` transition) fires on state *transitions*, not on initial build. +- [x] [Review][Patch] `fetchBiometricEnabled()` checks `generation != _generation` and returns early *before* ever checking `nameGeneration == _nameGeneration` — a fetch superseded only on its biometric-toggle generation (e.g. the double boot-time call in `main.dart`/`CerneApp.initState()` racing past the 2s `main()` timeout) discards its own still-valid `displayName`/`email` piggyback too, even though no `setDisplayName` call happened in between. [account_settings_repository_impl.dart:111-144] — fixed: the `nameGeneration` piggyback now applies before the `generation` check, independent of whether the biometric-toggle generation was superseded.

[test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:68-80] — fixed: added a widget test using the gate to prove the saving indicator shows and tap-away is a no-op mid-save.
+- [x] [Review][Patch] The profile e-mail `Text` has no `maxLines`/`overflow` handling, unlike the adjacent name `Text` which was patched for exactly this (backend allows up to 80 chars) — a long e-mail can still wrap to multiple lines and misalign the row. [account_settings_screen.dart:220-224] — fixed: added matching `maxLines: 1`/`TextOverflow.ellipsis`.

4	import '../entities/session_status.dart';
5	
6	/// The epic's ONE new DI-singleton access point for session validity (AD) —
7	/// every later consumer (Story 1.5's overlay, Story 1.6's `go_router`
8	/// redirect, Epic 4/RF07) listens to [statusStream] rather than re-deriving
9	/// session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream (RNF09 — still
10	/// `Either<Failure, T>` for the one-shot [restoreSession] call).
11	abstract class SessionRepository {
12	  /// Broadcast stream of the current session status. Emits nothing until
13	  /// [restoreSession] (or a later story's own trigger) completes at least
14	  /// once — a `StreamBuilder` with no data yet is the brief-blank boot state
15	  /// `main.dart` relies on (RNF01's 300ms threshold).
16	  Stream<SessionStatus> get statusStream;
17	
18	  /// The last status emitted on [statusStream], read synchronously — `null`
19	  /// until [restoreSession] (or [markAuthenticated]) emits for the first
20	  /// time. Story 1.6's `go_router` `redirect` reads this directly (instead
21	  /// of awaiting the stream) so a redirect evaluation triggered the very
22	  /// same microtask as a status change always sees the up-to-date value.
23	  SessionStatus? get currentStatus;
24	
25	  /// Boot-time, unconditional refresh: exchanges any stored refresh token
26	  /// for a fresh pair via `auth-refresh`, persists the result, and emits the
27	  /// outcome on [statusStream]. No client-side expiry math — the server is
28	  /// the sole source of truth for validity.
29	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> restoreSession();
30	
31	  /// Story 1.6 — called by `AuthCubit.submit()`'s success branch, *before*
32	  /// it emits its own success state, so that a fresh login/signup is
33	  /// immediately reflected here: the access token is already persisted by
34	  /// that point (the repository saved it ahead of resolving), so this is a
35	  /// pure in-memory status flip, never a network/storage call. Without this
36	  /// running first, the `go_router` redirect triggered by the subsequent
37	  /// navigation would still see the pre-login status and bounce the user
38	  /// straight back to `/auth`.
39	  void markAuthenticated();
40	
41	  /// Releases the underlying stream resource. Wired as `get_it`'s
42	  /// `dispose:` callback on registration, so `resetCoreDependencies()`
43	  /// (`sl.reset()`) closes it instead of leaking a `StreamController` on
44	  /// every test teardown.
45	  Future<void> dispose();
46	}

2	/// stream exposed from the auth feature's domain layer"). No `loading`/`idle`
3	/// member: a `StreamBuilder` with no data yet is this story's "loading"
4	/// representation (`main.dart`), never an extra enum value for that.
5	///
6	/// Story 1.5 adds [expired] — a mid-session `AUTH_EXPIRED` while
7	/// [authenticated], signalled via `SessionExpiryNotifier` and bridged onto
8	/// this same stream by `SessionRepositoryImpl`. `main.dart` renders the

10	/// showing a recovery overlay only for the latter — never a third screen.
11	/// Per the spec's "Ask First" boundary, a future fourth value requires
12	/// renegotiating the epic's AD before being added.
13	enum SessionStatus { authenticated, unauthenticated, expired }

1	import 'dart:async';
2	
3	import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
4	import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
5	
6	import '../di/injection_container.dart';
7	import '../../features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart';
8	import '../../features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart';
9	import '../../features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart';
10	import '../../features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart';
11	import '../../features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart';
12	import '../../features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart';
13	import '../../features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart';
14	import '../../features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart';
15	import '../../features/chat/presentation/screens/chat_screen.dart';
16	import '../../features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart';
17	import '../../features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart';
18	import '../../features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart';
19	import '../../features/entries/presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit.dart';
20	import '../../features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart';
21	import '../../features/entries/presentation/screens/entry_detail_screen.dart';
22	import '../../features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart';
23	import '../../features/vault/domain/entities/vault_status.dart';
24	import '../../features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart';
25	import '../../features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart';
26	import 'app_route_paths.dart';
27	import 'placeholder_screens.dart';
28	
29	export 'app_route_paths.dart';
30	
31	/// The epic's ONE `GoRouter`/`redirect` (Boundaries: "never a second
32	/// competing `redirect`") — composes [VaultRepository.currentStatus] first,
33	/// then [SessionRepository.currentStatus] (AD-14). All three repositories
34	/// are taken as parameters (rather than this file reaching into `sl`
35	/// itself) purely so a test can pass fakes/mocks directly, without
36	/// touching the global DI container; `AccountSettingsRepository` (Story
37	/// 2.4) plays no part in `_redirect` and needs no `refreshListenable` entry
38	/// of its own — `currentBiometricEnabled` is read synchronously at
39	/// `/vault`'s own build time below, same convention `_redirect` already
40	/// uses for `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`, so every fresh navigation into
41	/// `/vault` (triggered by those two streams, as already happens today)
42	/// already picks up the latest value correctly. (Review finding: a
43	/// `biometricEnabledStream` entry was tried here to also cover a value
44	/// changing while already resident at `/vault`, but go_router 18.1.1's
45	/// `GoRouterDelegate.setNewRoutePath` short-circuits whenever the matched
46	/// `RouteMatchList` is unchanged — which it always is here, since
47	/// `_redirect` stays at `/vault` before and after — so the route's
48	/// `builder` is never actually re-invoked that way; removed as dead code
49	/// rather than kept as a misleading no-op. That's a one-time, benign gap —
50	/// at most one extra biometric prompt on a slow-network cold boot, never a
51	/// security or dead-end issue, since PIN fallback is untouched and there's
52	/// no way to interrupt an in-flight native biometric dialog regardless —
53	/// which the frozen spec's I/O matrix never promised to cover.
54	/// `VaultLockScreen.didUpdateWidget` still defensively honors a changed
55	/// `attemptBiometricFirst` if the widget is ever rebuilt by some other
56	/// means.) The Configurações screen gets its own reactivity to this value
57	/// directly from `AccountSettingsCubit`'s independent subscription to
58	/// `biometricEnabledStream` — unrelated to routing.
59	///
60	/// [navigatorKey] is accepted explicitly (rather than letting `GoRouter`
61	/// generate its own internally) so the caller — `main.dart`'s
62	/// `ExpiryOverlayHost` — can reach the Navigator's own `BuildContext`
63	/// through the same, public, documented key instead of reaching into
64	/// `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` (not part of its public API).
65	GoRouter buildAppRouter({
66	  required VaultRepository vaultRepository,
67	  required SessionRepository sessionRepository,
68	  required AccountSettingsRepository accountSettingsRepository,
69	  required GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey,
70	}) {
71	  return GoRouter(
72	    navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
73	    initialLocation: AppRoutePaths.boot,
74	    refreshListenable: _GoRouterRefreshStream([
75	      vaultRepository.statusStream,
76	      sessionRepository.statusStream,
77	    ]),
78	    redirect: (context, state) =>
79	        _redirect(vaultRepository, sessionRepository, state),
80	    routes: [
81	      GoRoute(
82	        path: AppRoutePaths.vaultLock,
83	        builder: (context, state) => VaultLockScreen(
84	          vaultRepository: vaultRepository,
85	          // Story 2.4 — read synchronously, same sync-getter convention
86	          // `_redirect` already uses for `VaultStatus`/`SessionStatus`
87	          // below: `true` (the default before the boot fetch resolves)
88	          // attempts biometric first, `false` skips straight to the PIN
89	          // keypad (Boundaries).
90	          attemptBiometricFirst:
91	              accountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled,
92	        ),
93	      ),
94	      GoRoute(
95	        path: AppRoutePaths.boot,
96	        builder: (context, state) => const BootSplashScreen(),
97	      ),
98	      GoRoute(
99	        path: AppRoutePaths.auth,
100	        builder: (context, state) => AuthScreen(
101	          cubit: sl<AuthCubit>(),
102	          onAuthenticated: (context) => context.go(AppRoutePaths.home),
103	        ),
104	      ),
105	      GoRoute(
106	        path: AppRoutePaths.reauth,
107	        builder: (context, state) => const BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen(),
108	      ),
109	      GoRoute(
110	        path: AppRoutePaths.home,
111	        builder: (context, state) => ChatScreen(cubit: sl<ChatCubit>()),
112	      ),
113	      GoRoute(
114	        path: AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros,
115	        builder: (context, state) => MeusRegistrosScreen(
116	          cubit: sl<MeusRegistrosCubit>(),
117	          searchCubit: sl<EntriesSearchCubit>(),
118	        ),
119	        routes: [
120	          // spec-4-4 (RF07) — `:id` is either a real server id or a
121	          // still-pending/failed placeholder's synthetic `tempId`
122	          // (Boundaries: "a valid, un-special-cased navigation target");
123	          // `EntryDetailCubit` itself decides nothing about which kind it
124	          // is, it just calls `getById` with it verbatim.
125	          GoRoute(
126	            path: ':id',
127	            builder: (context, state) => EntryDetailScreen(
128	              cubit: sl<EntryDetailCubit>()..load(state.pathParameters['id']!),
129	            ),
130	          ),
131	        ],
132	      ),
133	      GoRoute(
134	        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
135	        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
136	      ),
137	      GoRoute(
138	        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
139	        builder: (context, state) => AccountSettingsScreen(
140	          cubit: sl<AccountSettingsCubit>(),
141	          dashboardCubit: sl<DashboardCubit>(),
142	          narrativeCubit: sl<DashboardNarrativeCubit>(),
143	        ),
144	      ),
145	    ],
146	  );
147	}
148	
149	/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
150	/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
151	/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
152	/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
153	///   other location is left alone *except* `/reauth` while already
154	///   `authenticated` (bounced home below — `/reauth` is meant to be
155	///   reached only by the expiry overlay's own explicit navigation while
156	///   `expired`, code review Story 1.6) — a mid-session expiry never
157	///   navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the three
158	///   non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
159	///
160	/// AD-14: Epic 2's `VaultStatus` gate (RF03) is composed first, strictly
161	/// ahead of every `SessionStatus` check below — the vault gate overrides
162	/// any location whenever it isn't `unlocked`, and only once it is does the
163	/// rest of this function (unchanged from Story 1.6) ever run.
164	String? _redirect(
165	  VaultRepository vaultRepository,
166	  SessionRepository sessionRepository,
167	  GoRouterState state,
168	) {
169	  final location = state.matchedLocation;
170	
171	  // AD-14 — checked before SessionStatus, per Boundaries ("`_redirect`
172	  // checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`"). `VaultStatus.locked` is
173	  // the default from construction (never `null`), so this never waits on
174	  // an async warm-up the way the `status == null` boot check below does.
175	  if (vaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked) {
176	    return location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock ? null : AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;
177	  }
178	
179	  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
180	
181	  if (status == null) {
182	    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
183	  }
184	
185	  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
186	    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
187	  }
188	
189	  // status is authenticated or expired.
190	  // `vaultLock` is included here too: once the vault unlocks while this
191	  // location is still `/vault` (the normal cold-start path once
192	  // `authenticate()` succeeds), the same fall-through that already bounces
193	  // `/boot`/`/auth` to Home applies — `/vault` is never a valid resting
194	  // place once `VaultStatus.unlocked`.
195	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot ||
196	      location == AppRoutePaths.auth ||
197	      location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock) {
198	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
199	  }
200	  // `/reauth` is a throwaway placeholder standing in for Epic 2's real
201	  // reauth flow; it should never be sitting open once the session is back
202	  // to fully `authenticated` (code review, Story 1.6).
203	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.reauth &&
204	      status == SessionStatus.authenticated) {
205	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
206	  }
207	  return null;
208	}
209	
210	/// Wraps [streams] as a single `Listenable` so `GoRouter`'s
211	/// `refreshListenable` can re-run [_redirect] on every emission from either
212	/// one — go_router 18.1.1 exports no `GoRouterRefreshStream` of its own
213	/// (Code Map), so this is that small local class. Extended by AD-14 to
214	/// subscribe to both the vault and the session streams (previously just
215	/// the one session stream), composing them into the one `Listenable`
216	/// `GoRouter` itself requires (Boundaries: "never a second
217	/// `GoRouter`/`redirect`").
218	class _GoRouterRefreshStream extends ChangeNotifier {
219	  _GoRouterRefreshStream(Iterable<Stream<dynamic>> streams) {
220	    _subscriptions = [
221	      for (final stream in streams)
222	        stream.listen(
223	          (_) => notifyListeners(),
224	          // Mirrors `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s own
225	          // subscriptions to this same stream — no current implementation
226	          // ever errors on it, but a future one that did must not surface
227	          // as an unhandled zone exception here specifically.
228	          onError: (_, _) {},
229	        ),
230	    ];
231	  }
232	
233	  late final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _subscriptions;
234	
235	  @override
236	  void dispose() {
237	    for (final subscription in _subscriptions) {
238	      subscription.cancel();
239	    }
240	    super.dispose();
241	  }
242	}

131:  summary: The `entries` Hive box (`lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart`) stores journal content in plaintext, with no encryption at rest.
132:  evidence: Nothing in `docs/input/` or the architecture spine requires or forbids local-storage encryption, so this wasn't a missed requirement — but this is the app's first `hive_ce` box, and it caches free-text journal content behind RF03's biometric/PIN access barrier, whose whole premise is restricting access to this exact data. Anyone who can read the device filesystem or an unencrypted backup bypasses that barrier entirely for entry content. Worth a deliberate encryption-at-rest decision (e.g. `hive_ce`'s `HiveCipher` with a key in `flutter_secure_storage`, mirroring how access tokens are already protected) before Epic 4 adds more boxes on the same unencrypted precedent.
134:  summary: `sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(entriesBox)` registers the entries box by bare generic type with no `instanceName` — the next feature that also opens a `Box<Map>` (every future `hive_ce` box, since AD-15 standardizes on raw server-shaped maps) will collide with or have to work around this registration.
135:  evidence: `get_it` resolves `sl<Box<Map>>()` by type alone; a second `registerSingleton<Box<Map>>` call for a different box (e.g. chat messages/sessions) would either throw on double-registration or silently shadow this one, depending on registration order. Needs a naming convention (e.g. `instanceName: 'entries'`) decided before the next `hive_ce` consumer is built, not discovered by it.
137:  summary: The entries Hive box is a single global box with no per-user namespacing and no clear-on-logout hook.
138:  evidence: Not exploitable today — no logout feature exists yet (Epic 8 backlog) — but Epic 4 starts reading from this same box, so a second account on a shared device would inherit the first account's cached entries unless this is addressed before a logout feature ships.
146:  summary: A local Hive-box write failure that happens *after* `entries-create` has already succeeded server-side maps to `Left(Failure.malformedResponse(...))` in `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create` — the same outcome as a genuine network/parse failure — so the cubit re-enables Salvar and invites a retry that fires a second, un-deduplicated `entries-create` call.
147:  evidence: `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:42-46`. The epic's own idempotency note (`epic-3-context.md`: "`create` on the port is idempotent on `(origin, chatMessageId)`, though that specific guard only matters starting with RF10") already scopes general duplicate-entry risk as out of this story's concern — this is the same accepted risk surfacing through a different trigger (a local disk failure instead of a user retry after a network failure). Revisit alongside that RF10 idempotency work, or sooner if local Hive write failures prove non-negligible in practice.
149:  summary: `Failure.malformedResponse(message: error.toString())` is used in both `entries_remote_data_source.dart`'s parse-failure catch and `entries_repository_impl.dart`'s Hive-write-failure catch, surfacing a raw Dart exception string (e.g. `"FormatException: ..."`) as the inline/announced message a user sees or hears.
152:  summary: `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create`'s Hive-write-failure catch reuses `Failure.malformedResponse`, whose own doc comment scopes it to "a 200 response that doesn't match the expected shape" (a parse failure) — not a local disk/Hive I/O failure, which is a different cause entirely.
155:  summary: An exception thrown by the new `Hive.initFlutter()`/`registerEntriesFeature()` calls during app bootstrap propagates out of `setupCoreDependencies()` uncaught — `main.dart`'s own `try`/`catch` around that call only logs and `rethrow`s, so the app still crashes with no fallback UI.
156:  evidence: `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:90-92`, `lib/main.dart:17-26`. Pre-existing behavior, not introduced by this story — every one of the five feature registrations `setupCoreDependencies()` already performs (auth/vault/account, now entries/capture) shares the exact same fatal-crash-on-failure contract, and `main.dart`'s catch block's own message is already `.env`-specific wording predating this diff. Revisit only as part of a deliberate app-wide bootstrap-resilience decision, not a one-off fix for the Hive call alone.
158:  summary: `EntrySource.audio`/`EntrySource.photo` are never exercised through `EntriesRemoteDataSource`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s real serialization or Hive round-trip — only `manual` (this story) and `chat` are covered.
236:  summary: The `entries` Hive box grows without bound (every successful `list()`/`loadMore()` persists every item seen, forever, with no eviction/TTL), and `EntriesRepositoryImpl._offlineFallback()` reads and sorts the box's entire `.values` on every offline-triggered call — both cost grow unbounded over a long-lived app session.
246:  evidence: Review finding (code-review, post-implementation review round, blind-hunter layer). Performance-only concern, not a correctness bug — current page sizes (20/page) keep the cost small. Combined with the already-deferred unbounded Hive-box growth above, this recompute cost also has no ceiling; worth addressing together once a real dataset-size problem is observed.
254:  summary: The pre-existing real-`hive_ce`-round-trip `entries_repository_impl_integration_test.dart` was not extended by this story — it still only round-trips `create()`. The new `list()`/`_offlineFallback()` path (box `putAll`, box `.values` dump+sort) is only ever exercised against a `MockBox`, never against a real Hive instance, unlike `create()`'s own coverage.
255:  evidence: Review finding (code-review, post-implementation review round, blind-hunter layer). Parity nice-to-have, not a documented requirement of this story's Verification section (which only asks for `fvm flutter test` passing, already satisfied by the mocked-`Box` unit tests). Worth extending once a real Hive-specific bug surfaces that mocked tests can't catch.
299:  summary: `EntriesRepositoryImpl._cachedEntryOrOriginalFailure` (added for `getById`) duplicates the "decode cached Hive JSON → `EntryDto`, map a throw to `Left(malformedResponse)`" logic `_offlineFallback()` (used by `list()`) already implements, rather than sharing one helper.
348:  summary: No e2e test exercises `entries-search` with `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` over the real network/Hive pipeline (real `UrlBuilder`/interceptors/`Dio`) — only the mocked-`ApiClient` tier (`entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`) and the fake-repository tier (cubit/widget tests) cover the new combined-query params.
357:  summary: `Hive.openBox<Map>(...)` calls are unguarded (no try/catch) across the codebase — a corrupted/locked box would crash app startup — surfaced here for `lib/features/chat/chat_injection.dart`'s two new boxes, but the exact same unguarded pattern already exists in `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart:28` and presumably every other `hive_ce` box opened at DI time.
358:  evidence: `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart:28` (`final entriesBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(entriesBoxName);`, no surrounding try/catch) confirms this predates story 6.1 and is a cross-cutting Hive-resilience gap, not something chat introduced — worth a dedicated hardening pass across all features rather than a one-off fix inside chat's own injection file.
378:  summary: The two new `chat_sessions`/`chat_messages` Hive boxes accumulate every session/message ever fetched, with no eviction/TTL.
379:  evidence: `lib/features/chat/chat_injection.dart`. Review finding (code-review, blind-hunter layer). Same unbounded-growth pattern already deferred for the `entries` Hive box (spec-4-1's own deferred-work entry) — not called out anywhere in the spec or epic-context as a future concern, so flagging here so it isn't forgotten once Story 6.2 (multi-session history) starts growing this data faster.
403:  evidence: `lib/features/chat/presentation/cubit/chat_cubit.dart`, `lib/core/widgets/app_drawer.dart`. Review finding (blind-hunter layer). Same unbounded-growth concern class already deferred for the `chat_sessions`/`chat_messages` Hive boxes (this file's own story-6-1 entries above), but this instance is in-memory and also risks jank from non-virtualized rendering with many sessions.
465:  summary: A successful `retryMessage` never writes the regenerated content back to the local Hive cache — if the app is force-closed right after a successful retry and relaunched offline, the cached copy of that message still shows its stale/failed content.
466:  evidence: `lib/features/chat/data/repositories/chat_repository_impl.dart` (`retryMessage`). Review finding (blind-hunter layer). Mirrors `sendMessage`'s own pre-existing "pure passthrough, no Hive persistence" design from story 6.1 — not a new asymmetry introduced by this story.
486:  summary: `EntriesRepositoryImpl.create()` calls the remote data source first, then writes to the local Hive `entries` box — if that local `put()` throws, it returns `Left(malformedResponse)` even though the Entry was already durably created on the backend, so a bookmark save can show `error` (inviting a retry) for a save that actually already succeeded.

Same unbounded-growth concern class already deferred for the `chat_sessions`/`chat_messages` Hive boxes (this file's own story-6-1 entries above), but this instance is in-memory and also risks jank from non-virtualized rendering with many sessions.
465:  summary: A successful `retryMessage` never writes the regenerated content back to the local Hive cache — if the app is force-closed right after a successful retry and relaunched offline, the cached copy of that message still shows its stale/failed content.

1	import 'package:hive_ce/hive_ce.dart';
2	
3	import '../../core/di/injection_container.dart';
4	import '../../core/network/api_client.dart';
5	import '../auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart';
6	import 'data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart';
7	import 'data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart';
8	import 'domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart';
9	import 'domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
10	import 'domain/usecases/save_chat_message_as_entry_use_case.dart';
11	import 'presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart';
12	import 'presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit.dart';
13	import 'presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart';
14	
15	/// The `entries` Hive box's name — the first `hive_ce` box in the app
16	/// (Code Map). A raw `Box<Map>`, not a generated `HiveObject`/
17	/// `TypeAdapter` (Design Notes: avoids adapter codegen) — spec-4-1's
18	/// `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` is this box's first reader
19	/// (`create()`'s own writes were, until then, never read back by
20	/// anything).
21	const entriesBoxName = 'entries';
22	
23	/// Registers the `entries` feature into the project's single `get_it`
24	/// instance (`sl`) — mirrors `features/account/account_injection.dart`'s
25	/// pattern. Called from `setupCoreDependencies()` right after
26	/// `Hive.initFlutter()` (Code Map), which must already have run by the
27	/// time this opens its box.
28	Future<void> registerEntriesFeature() async {
29	  final entriesBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(entriesBoxName);
30	  sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(entriesBox);
31	
32	  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(
33	    () => EntriesRemoteDataSource(sl<ApiClient>()),
34	  );
35	
36	  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRepository>(
37	    () => EntriesRepositoryImpl(
38	      remoteDataSource: sl<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(),
39	      entriesBox: sl<Box<Map>>(),
40	    ),
41	  );
42	
43	  // spec-4-2 — one shared tracker for all three capture cubits
44	  // (`capture_injection.dart`) *and* `MeusRegistrosCubit` below, so a
45	  // pending write started from any capture cubit is visible to the other
46	  // regardless of which "+" tap created it (Design Notes).
47	  sl.registerLazySingleton<PendingEntryWriteTracker>(
48	    () => PendingEntryWriteTrackerImpl(repository: sl<EntriesRepository>()),
49	    dispose: (tracker) => tracker.dispose(),
50	  );
51	
52	  // spec-6-4 (RF10) — the shared use case `ChatCubit.bookmarkMessage`
53	  // depends on (AGENTS.md's RF10 rule), registered here (not in
54	  // `chat_injection.dart`) since it wraps `EntriesRepository`, the entries
55	  // feature's own port; `registerChatFeature()` runs after this one
56	  // (`injection_container.dart`), so `sl<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>()`
57	  // is always already registered by the time `chat_injection.dart` wires
58	  // it into `ChatCubit`.
59	  sl.registerLazySingleton<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>(
60	    () => SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCaseImpl(sl<EntriesRepository>()),
61	  );
62	
63	  // spec-4-1 — `MeusRegistrosCubit` is a `lazySingleton`, not a factory
64	  // (Code Map/Boundaries), like `AccountSettingsCubit`: long-lived, so
65	  // `dispose:` wires its `close()` into `get_it`'s own reset lifecycle,
66	  // same convention `account_injection.dart` already uses.
67	  sl.registerLazySingleton<MeusRegistrosCubit>(
68	    () => MeusRegistrosCubit(
69	      sl<EntriesRepository>(),
70	      sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>(),
71	    ),
72	    dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close(),
73	  );
74	
75	  // spec-5-1 — `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` too (Code Map),
76	  // mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit` immediately above: long-lived, so
77	  // `dispose:` wires its `close()` into `get_it`'s own reset lifecycle the
78	  // same way.
79	  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesSearchCubit>(
80	    () => EntriesSearchCubit(sl<EntriesRepository>()),
81	    dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close(),

14	/// The `chat_sessions`/`chat_messages` Hive box names — two boxes (Code
15	/// Map: "Hive box cache for `listSessions`/`listMessages`"), mirroring
16	/// `entries_injection.dart`'s `entriesBoxName` pattern but split in two
17	/// since each caches a structurally different DTO shape.
18	const chatSessionsBoxName = 'chat_sessions';
19	const chatMessagesBoxName = 'chat_messages';
20	
21	/// Registers the `chat` feature into the project's single `get_it`
22	/// instance (`sl`) — mirrors `entries_injection.dart`'s pattern. Called
23	/// from `setupCoreDependencies()` after `Hive.initFlutter()` has already
24	/// run (Code Map), same ordering requirement `registerEntriesFeature()`
25	/// documents for itself.
26	Future<void> registerChatFeature() async {
27	  final sessionsBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(chatSessionsBoxName);
28	  final messagesBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(chatMessagesBoxName);
29	  // `instanceName` disambiguates the two `Box<Map>` singletons from each
30	  // other and from `entries_injection.dart`'s own unnamed one — `get_it`
31	  // keys a registration by type + instance name, so three same-typed
32	  // singletons coexist safely.
33	  sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(
34	    sessionsBox,
35	    instanceName: chatSessionsBoxName,
36	  );
37	  sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(
38	    messagesBox,
39	    instanceName: chatMessagesBoxName,
40	  );
41	
42	  sl.registerLazySingleton<ChatRemoteDataSource>(
43	    () => ChatRemoteDataSource(sl<ApiClient>()),
44	  );
45	
46	  sl.registerLazySingleton<ChatRepository>(
47	    () => ChatRepositoryImpl(
48	      remoteDataSource: sl<ChatRemoteDataSource>(),
49	      sessionsBox: sl<Box<Map>>(instanceName: chatSessionsBoxName),
50	      messagesBox: sl<Box<Map>>(instanceName: chatMessagesBoxName),
51	    ),
52	  );
53	
54	  // spec-6-3 — one real `Connectivity`/`ConnectivityWatcher` for the
55	  // app's lifetime, mirroring `capture_injection.dart`'s own
56	  // `record_pkg.AudioRecorder`/`MicRecorder` registration shape.
57	  sl.registerLazySingleton<Connectivity>(Connectivity.new);
58	  sl.registerLazySingleton<ConnectivityWatcher>(
59	    () => ConnectivityPlusWatcher(connectivity: sl<Connectivity>()),
60	  );
61	
62	  // A `lazySingleton`, not a factory (Code Map), mirroring
63	  // `MeusRegistrosCubit`: long-lived, so a session bootstrapped on one
64	  // visit to Home/Chat survives leaving and returning within the same app
65	  // session (`ChatCubit.init()`'s own no-op guard). `dispose:` wires
66	  // `close()` into `get_it`'s own reset lifecycle, same convention every
67	  // other long-lived cubit in this codebase already uses.
68	  // spec-6-4 (RF10) — `sl<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>()` is registered
69	  // by `registerEntriesFeature()`, which `setupCoreDependencies()` always
70	  // runs before this function (`injection_container.dart`), so it's
71	  // already available here; only the use-case file is imported above,
72	  // never `entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` (AGENTS.md
73	  // RF10 rule).
74	  sl.registerLazySingleton<ChatCubit>(
75	    () => ChatCubit(
76	      sl<ChatRepository>(),
77	      sl<ConnectivityWatcher>(),
78	      sl<SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase>(),
79	    ),
80	    dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close(),
81	  );
82	}

17	  /// box (Code Map): on [Failure.networkOffline]/[Failure.networkTimeout],

19	  /// convention `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` already uses for its own

25	  /// (Boundaries: "`chat-sessions-create` with no title") — blocked

28	  /// every [Failure], including [Failure.networkOffline], is returned as

30	  /// `chat_sessions` Hive box before returning `Right`, same
31	  /// "persist then return" ordering [listSessions] already uses.
32	  Future<Either<Failure, ChatSession>> createSession();

35	  /// the one trailing path segment) — works offline via the

44	  /// (Boundaries/RNF09: "every other method returns

46	  /// to a single `Left(Failure.networkOffline)` emission, never queued

1	import 'dart:async';
2	
3	import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
4	
5	import '../../domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart';
6	
7	/// Drives [AccountSettingsScreen]: just the one toggle's current value
8	/// (mirrored straight from [AccountSettingsRepository.biometricEnabledStream]
9	/// — the repository is the single source of truth, Boundaries) plus an
10	/// inline error message for a failed toggle.
11	class AccountSettingsState {
12	  const AccountSettingsState({
13	    required this.biometricEnabled,
14	    this.errorMessage,
15	    this.isSaving = false,
16	    this.displayName = '',
17	    this.email = '',
18	    this.isEditingName = false,
19	    this.nameDraft = '',
20	    this.isSavingName = false,
21	    this.nameErrorMessage,
22	  });
23	
24	  final bool biometricEnabled;
25	
26	  /// Set only once [AccountSettingsCubit.toggleBiometric]'s own PATCH call
27	  /// fails — the switch itself has already reverted via the repository's
28	  /// own stream by the time this is shown (I/O matrix: "Toggle fails ->
29	  /// switch reverts ... Failure.message shown inline").
30	  final String? errorMessage;
31	
32	  /// Review finding: `true` for the duration of one [toggleBiometric] call
33	  /// — `account_settings_screen.dart` disables the `Switch` while this is
34	  /// `true`, so a double-tap can never start a second, overlapping
35	  /// `setBiometricEnabled` call in the first place (the repository's own
36	  /// generation guard is the backstop for every other overlap this can't
37	  /// prevent, e.g. a boot fetch racing a toggle).
38	  final bool isSaving;
39	
40	  /// spec-8-3 — the profile name shown in display mode, read from
41	  /// `AccountSettingsRepository.currentDisplayName` at construction
42	  /// (Boundaries), then kept in sync by [AccountSettingsCubit.
43	  /// confirmEditingName]'s own success branch — never re-read from the
44	  /// repository afterwards.
45	  final String displayName;
46	
47	  /// spec-8-3 — the account e-mail, read the same way as [displayName] and
48	  /// never written anywhere (not editable — "email is rejected").
49	  final String email;
50	
51	  /// spec-8-3 — `true` while the name is in its inline-editable form (the
52	  /// pencil icon has become a check). Boundaries: "startEditingName()
53	  /// (draft = current name)".
54	  final bool isEditingName;
55	
56	  /// spec-8-3 — the in-progress edit's own text, separate from
57	  /// [displayName] until [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName] commits
58	  /// it. Kept exactly as typed (not trimmed) so a failed save redisplays
59	  /// the same text the user left in the field (Boundaries: "draft kept").
60	  final String nameDraft;
61	
62	  /// spec-8-3 — `true` for the duration of one
63	  /// [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName] PATCH call. Mirrors
64	  /// [isSaving]'s own role for the biometric toggle, kept as its own field
65	  /// (Boundaries: "never: merging name-edit into the toggle's own state").
66	  final bool isSavingName;
67	
68	  /// spec-8-3 — set only once [AccountSettingsCubit.confirmEditingName]'s
69	  /// own PATCH call fails; the field stays editable with [nameDraft]
70	  /// unchanged (I/O matrix: "Failure -> stays editing, inline error, draft
71	  /// kept").
72	  final String? nameErrorMessage;
73	
74	  AccountSettingsState copyWith({
75	    bool? biometricEnabled,
76	    String? errorMessage,
77	    bool clearErrorMessage = false,
78	    bool? isSaving,
79	    String? displayName,
80	    String? email,
81	    bool? isEditingName,
82	    String? nameDraft,
83	    bool? isSavingName,
84	    String? nameErrorMessage,
85	    bool clearNameErrorMessage = false,
86	  }) {
87	    return AccountSettingsState(
88	      biometricEnabled: biometricEnabled ?? this.biometricEnabled,
89	      errorMessage: clearErrorMessage
90	          ? null
91	          : (errorMessage ?? this.errorMessage),
92	      isSaving: isSaving ?? this.isSaving,
93	      displayName: displayName ?? this.displayName,
94	      email: email ?? this.email,
95	      isEditingName: isEditingName ?? this.isEditingName,
96	      nameDraft: nameDraft ?? this.nameDraft,
97	      isSavingName: isSavingName ?? this.isSavingName,
98	      nameErrorMessage: clearNameErrorMessage
99	          ? null
100	          : (nameErrorMessage ?? this.nameErrorMessage),
101	    );
102	  }
103	
104	  @override
105	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
106	      identical(this, other) ||
107	      (other is AccountSettingsState &&
108	          other.biometricEnabled == biometricEnabled &&
109	          other.errorMessage == errorMessage &&
110	          other.isSaving == isSaving &&
111	          other.displayName == displayName &&
112	          other.email == email &&
113	          other.isEditingName == isEditingName &&
114	          other.nameDraft == nameDraft &&
115	          other.isSavingName == isSavingName &&
116	          other.nameErrorMessage == nameErrorMessage);
117	
118	  @override
119	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
120	    biometricEnabled,
121	    errorMessage,
122	    isSaving,
123	    displayName,
124	    email,
125	    isEditingName,
126	    nameDraft,
127	    isSavingName,
128	    nameErrorMessage,
129	  );
130	
131	  @override
132	  String toString() =>
133	      'AccountSettingsState(biometricEnabled: $biometricEnabled, '
134	      'errorMessage: $errorMessage, isSaving: $isSaving, '
135	      'displayName: $displayName, email: $email, '
136	      'isEditingName: $isEditingName, nameDraft: $nameDraft, '
137	      'isSavingName: $isSavingName, nameErrorMessage: $nameErrorMessage)';
138	}
139	
140	/// Calls [AccountSettingsRepository] directly (no use-case — same small-
141	/// scope rationale `AuthCubit`'s own doc gives). [toggleBiometric] is the
142	/// I/O matrix's optimistic flip/revert, end to end: the repository itself
143	/// flips [AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled] immediately
144	/// and emits it on [AccountSettingsRepository.biometricEnabledStream] —
145	/// this cubit only mirrors that stream into its own [AccountSettingsState]
146	/// (subscribed once, at construction) and separately layers the
147	/// toggle-failure error message on top.
148	class AccountSettingsCubit extends Cubit<AccountSettingsState> {
149	  AccountSettingsCubit(this._repository)
150	    : super(
151	        AccountSettingsState(
152	          biometricEnabled: _repository.currentBiometricEnabled,
153	          // spec-8-3 — read once, at construction (Boundaries); never
154	          // re-read from the repository afterwards.
155	          displayName: _repository.currentDisplayName,
156	          email: _repository.currentEmail,
157	        ),
158	      ) {
159	    _subscription = _repository.biometricEnabledStream.listen((value) {
160	      // Review finding: `biometricEnabledStream`'s first delivery always
161	      // replays the exact same value the constructor above just read
162	      // synchronously — without this check, that replay was a redundant
163	      // duplicate emission (not skipped by `Cubit`'s own equal-state dedup,
164	      // which only applies once something has already been emitted),
165	      // forcing one pointless extra rebuild right after every screen mount.
166	      if (value == state.biometricEnabled) {
167	        return;
168	      }
169	      emit(state.copyWith(biometricEnabled: value));
170	    });
171	  }
172	
173	  final AccountSettingsRepository _repository;
174	  late final StreamSubscription<bool> _subscription;
175	
176	  Future<void> toggleBiometric(bool value) async {
177	    emit(state.copyWith(clearErrorMessage: true, isSaving: true));
178	    final result = await _repository.setBiometricEnabled(value);
179	    // Review finding: this cubit is a `get_it` lazy singleton with
180	    // `dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close()` — if `close()` runs while the
181	    // `await` above is still pending (e.g. `resetCoreDependencies()`
182	    // during a logout, once Epic 8 implements one), `emit()` below would
183	    // otherwise throw a `StateError` ("Cannot emit new states after
184	    // calling close"), unlike the repository-layer `_emit` methods in this
185	    // codebase, which already guard against the equivalent race.
186	    if (isClosed) {
187	      return;
188	    }
189	    result.match((failure) {
190	      // Review finding: a superseded call's `Left` is an internal
191	      // control-flow signal (`AccountSettingsRepository.
192	      // supersededMessage`), not a real error — the winning call already
193	      // settled the value correctly, so nothing should be shown; showing
194	      // `failure.message` unconditionally leaked that raw, English,
195	      // internal string into this otherwise fully Portuguese screen.
196	      if (failure.message == AccountSettingsRepository.supersededMessage) {
197	        emit(state.copyWith(isSaving: false));
198	        return;
199	      }
200	      emit(state.copyWith(errorMessage: failure.message, isSaving: false));
201	    }, (_) => emit(state.copyWith(isSaving: false)));
202	  }
203	
204	  /// Review finding: [errorMessage] previously cleared only at the start of
205	  /// the *next* [toggleBiometric] call — since this cubit is a DI
206	  /// singleton that outlives any single Configurações visit, a failed
207	  /// toggle's error text would otherwise still be showing if the user
208	  /// left the screen and came back later with no new attempt made.
209	  /// `account_settings_screen.dart` calls this once, on mount, same
210	  /// "stale message must not linger unchanged" fix already applied to
211	  /// `vault_lock_screen.dart`'s own PIN-mismatch error, just anchored to
212	  /// screen-entry instead of attempt-start.
213	  void clearStaleError() {
214	    if (state.errorMessage != null) {
215	      emit(state.copyWith(clearErrorMessage: true));
216	    }
217	  }
218	
219	  /// spec-8-3 — tapping the pencil icon (I/O matrix: "Tap pencil ->
220	  /// `isEditingName: false` -> Field replaces name, draft = current, icon
221	  /// -> check"). Also clears any leftover [AccountSettingsState.
222	  /// nameErrorMessage] from a previous failed attempt.
223	  void startEditingName() {
224	    emit(
225	      state.copyWith(
226	        isEditingName: true,
227	        nameDraft: state.displayName,
228	        clearNameErrorMessage: true,
229	      ),
230	    );
231	  }
232	
233	  /// spec-8-3 — mirrors the field's own `onChanged`, kept as the single
234	  /// source [confirmEditingName] reads from.
235	  void updateNameDraft(String value) {
236	    emit(state.copyWith(nameDraft: value));
237	  }
238	
239	  /// spec-8-3 — I/O matrix: "Tap away, not saving -> Reverts, draft
240	  /// discarded, no PATCH" / "Tap away, saving -> No-op, save completes".
241	  /// A no-op while [AccountSettingsState.isSavingName] (Boundaries) — the
242	  /// in-flight [confirmEditingName] call owns the eventual transition back
243	  /// to display mode.
244	  void cancelEditingName() {
245	    if (state.isSavingName) {
246	      return;
247	    }
248	    emit(state.copyWith(isEditingName: false, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
249	  }
250	
251	  /// spec-8-3 — tapping the check icon. Trims [AccountSettingsState.
252	  /// nameDraft] only for the empty/unchanged comparison and the PATCH
253	  /// payload itself; an empty or unchanged draft reverts immediately with
254	  /// no PATCH (I/O matrix). Otherwise awaits
255	  /// `AccountSettingsRepository.setDisplayName` (not optimistic,
256	  /// Boundaries) — success reverts to display mode showing the new name;
257	  /// failure stays in edit mode with the draft kept and an inline error.
258	  Future<void> confirmEditingName() async {
259	    final trimmed = state.nameDraft.trim();
260	    if (trimmed.isEmpty || trimmed == state.displayName) {
261	      emit(state.copyWith(isEditingName: false, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
262	      return;
263	    }
264	    emit(state.copyWith(isSavingName: true, clearNameErrorMessage: true));
265	    final result = await _repository.setDisplayName(trimmed);
266	    // Same close()-race guard as toggleBiometric's own.
267	    if (isClosed) {
268	      return;
269	    }
270	    result.match(
271	      (failure) {
272	        // Same superseded-message filtering convention as toggleBiometric's
273	        // own failure branch — an internal control-flow signal, not a real
274	        // error to show.
275	        if (failure.message == AccountSettingsRepository.supersededMessage) {
276	          emit(state.copyWith(isSavingName: false));
277	          return;
278	        }
279	        emit(
280	          state.copyWith(
281	            isSavingName: false,
282	            nameErrorMessage: failure.message,
283	          ),
284	        );
285	      },
286	      (_) {
287	        // Review finding: reads the repository's own echoed value (set
288	        // from `dto.displayName` in `setDisplayName`'s success branch),
289	        // not the locally-sent `trimmed` string — any backend-side
290	        // normalization (trimming, casing, etc.) must reach this state,
291	        // the one place the user actually sees the name, not just the
292	        // repository's own internal cache.
293	        emit(
294	          state.copyWith(
295	            isEditingName: false,
296	            isSavingName: false,
297	            displayName: _repository.currentDisplayName,
298	            clearNameErrorMessage: true,
299	          ),
300	        );
301	      },
302	    );
303	  }
304	
305	  @override
306	  Future<void> close() async {
307	    await _subscription.cancel();
308	    return super.close();
309	  }
310	}
311

---
title: 'Story 8.4: Logout'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-08'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações has no way to end the session — "Sair" is a dead action (epic-8-context.md's Story 8.4 scope; FR-42, RF03).

**Approach:** Add `logout()`/`lock()`/`clearLocalCache()` to `SessionRepository`/`VaultRepository`/`EntriesRepository`/`ChatRepository` respectively; `AccountSettingsCubit` orchestrates all four behind one `logout()` call triggered by a new "Sair" button. No new navigation code — the existing `app_router.dart` redirect (already watching both streams) takes the user to Biometria once the vault relocks.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `SessionRepository.logout()` (mirrors `restoreSession()`'s shape): calls new `AuthRemoteDataSource.logout()` (`POST auth-logout`, bearerAuth, no body), then UNCONDITIONALLY (regardless of that result) calls `AccessTokenProvider.clearSession()` and emits `SessionStatus.unauthenticated` — "hand my phone to someone else" must work even offline.

title: 'Story 8.4: Logout'
type: 'feature'
